script_text: Cancer, this week cracks open a secret you have been avoiding. Monday to Wednesday, Mercury conjuncts the Sun in your 5th House, so romance and creative work heat up fast, revealing old secrets. Tuesday feels heavy because the Moon squares Saturn in your 9th House, challenging old beliefs. Midweek, Venus in your 5th House trines your ruling Moon, turning a shy crush into deep real intimacy. Thursday to Sunday, Mars in your 5th House squares Jupiter in your 2nd House, so passion and pay clash. Weekend energy settles when your Water nature seeks calm, so choose one gentle cozy commitment, not five. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your ruling Moon. Saturday is your worst day because the Moon suddenly opposes Neptune in your 10th House, blurring truth. Ask for what you need today before resentment speaks for you. Follow for daily updates.
